# PomodoroManager

> **File:** `services/apps/PomodoroManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

The pomodoro timer: one for every widget and module, run here so it keeps time with nothing showing it. The state (PomodoroCycle's) holds an absolute end time, so it survives a QML reload (PersistentProperties) and a restart (StateManager "pomodoro"); a phase that ended while axiom wasn't running moves on quietly. A notification marks each end (with Pomodoro.notify); clicking it opens a page or edge menu with the timer. Displays acquire(owner) the once-a-second `now`; the end itself needs no one. axiom ipc pomodoro toggle

### Properties

- `state` (readonly var)
- `phase` (readonly string)
- `running` (readonly bool)
- `isBreak` (readonly bool)
- `idle` (readonly bool): Neither running nor paused part way
- `completed` (readonly int)
- `remaining` (readonly real): Ms left, and 0–1 through the phase, as of `now`
- `progress` (readonly real)
- `remainingText` (readonly string)
- `now` (real): Updated every second while running and acquired
- `todoUid` (readonly string): The todo the sessions are for ("" for none), and its text
- `todoText` (readonly string)
- `phaseLabel` (readonly string): I18n.tr("Focus") I18n.tr("Short break") I18n.tr("Long break")

### Functions

- `remainingTextNow()`: The time left as of this moment, for a reader holding no acquire (the launcher, IPC): `remainingText` follows `now`, which ticks only while something has acquired it
- `acquire(owner)`
- `release(owner)`
- `start()`
- `pause()`
- `toggle()`
- `skip()`: Ends this phase now and goes to the next, without a notification
- `stop()`: Back to a focus session not yet started (the count stays)
- `reset()`: Stopped, and the session count back to 0
- `setTodo(uid)`
- `openTimer()`: A page or edge menu with a Pomodoro or Focus module; false with none
